segments.text:
V. 36.
And behold thy couſin Eliſabeth—Tho' Eliſabeth was of the Houſe of Aaron, and Mary of the Houſe of David, by the Father's Side, they might be related by their Mother's. For the Law only forbad Heireſſes marrying into another Tribe. And ſo other Perſons continually intermarried: Particularly, the Families of David and of Levi.
